attack.expected_effect: Alter the SQL predicate so that records outside the legitimate search match are returned.
attack.observed_effect: All three records in application_data were returned.

root_cause.description: User-controlled input from the message parameter was directly interpolated into a SQL query string.
root_cause.vulnerable_pattern: String interpolation of untrusted input into a SQL WHERE clause.

impact.integrity: No database rows were modified or deleted.

expected_remediation.primary: Replace direct SQL string interpolation with a parameterized SQL query.
secondary: Validate and constrain the search input.
Add a regression test demonstrating that SQL metacharacters cannot alter query semantics.

malicious_request.expected_result_after_remediation: The input must not cause records outside the legitimate search semantics to be returned.
